artworks.title: Chief Jumper of the Seminoles
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body from the chest up. He is positioned slightly to the side, looking to the left. The man has a strong jawline, dark hair mostly covered by a red headwrap, deep brown skin, a shirt with colored flower patterns, a red sash with geometric designs, and a long silver earring on his left ear. The background is dark with no discernible objects.

artworks.title: The Colonel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a half-length portrait of a person shown from the waist up. The individual is standing with a confident posture, one hand positioned at their waist. Their facial features include a prominent mustache and pointed beard, with slightly arched eyebrows and a direct gaze. The person's hair is a dark shade, styled close to the head and visible beneath their hat. They are wearing a dark blue military uniform adorned with yellow buttons and shoulder insignia, along with a yellow and red belt. The hat is also dark blue with a yellow emblem that has the letters "US," circled by a decorative design. The person also wears yellow gloves on their hand. The background of the image is a muted, textured surface in shades of gray.

artworks.title: Samuel Griffin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a full-body portrait of a seated man. He is positioned slightly turned to his left with his legs crossed. His facial features show a calm expression, and he has light skin and white hair that is styled backward. The man is wearing formal attire that includes a dark blue coat with large gold buttons, a yellow waistcoat, a white neck scarf with floral patterns, knee-length black breeches, and light blue stockings. He sits on a wooden chair next to a round wooden table, on which there is an open book and a small rectangular object. The background features a green wall with an ornamental border and a large, empty fireplace behind him. The floor is covered with a light-colored carpet that has a simple pattern.

artworks.title: Textile Merchant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows the upper body of a man seated at a table. He is holding a quill over a sheet of paper, and his body is turned slightly to the right as he looks out at us. He has a fair complexion, large green eyes, a straight nose, and a neutral expression. He has dark, wavy hair, and is dressed in a formal black jacket with a white shirt underneath, a black bow tie, and a yellow waistcoat adorned with a gold-colored chain and a pin. On the brown table he sits behind, there is an ink pot with another quill in it, and a thick brown book partially covered by the paper he writes on. Behind his head are rolls of patterned fabric on shelves, along with several blue boxes. The walls are a dark green color, and on the right is a bright red curtain with a black pattern on the gold-fringed edges.

artworks.title: Profile Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in profile view facing left. The man has a straight posture, with prominent facial features including a nose and chin. His hair is dark, curly, and close to his head, with some volume on top. He wears a dark suit, high-collared white shirt, and black cravat. The background is plain grayish-blue with no visible objects.

artworks.title: Profile Portrait of a Lady
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person in profile, facing to the right with a slightly turned head. The person has fair skin, straight nose, and a slight smile. The brown hair is styled in an updo with tight curls around the face. They wear a black garment with a light shawl, a rectangular clasp, and a triple-strand necklace with a central gold or amber pendant. The background is a simple, muted gray.

artworks.title: Anonymous Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a straight posture. He has fair skin, dark brown hair styled neatly, and a neutral expression. He wears a high-collared white shirt, a dark suit with a black coat, a black waistcoat, and brown trousers. The background is a smooth gradient of light to dark blue.

artworks.title: Anonymous Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with a small red book in her right hand. She has a fair complexion, neutral expression, slightly arched eyebrows, and small, rounded lips. Her dark brown hair is styled in an updo with a black accessory. She wears a high-necked dark dress with puffed sleeves and a white collar. The background is plain blue. The woman is not wearing any visible jewelry, and the setting is minimalistic with only the book present.

artworks.title: Attack on Bunker's Hill, with the Burning of Charles Town
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: We look across and down at a channel of water separating two landmasses labeled "Boston" and "Charles Town" in this horizontal landscape painting. Four three-masted ships are in the aquamarine-blue harbor between us and the land. Three of them have their sails unfurled and smoke billows from the broad, starboard side of each. Tidy rows of brown houses line the area of Boston. A puff of white smoke rises from the farthest point. Two arrow-shaped missiles, perhaps projectiles on fire, arc toward Charles Town, where billowing gray plumes of smoke rise from vivid orange fire on the far side of the landmass. Rowboats bring soldiers to the shore of Charles Town, close to where hundreds of soldiers line up and fire at each other. Much of the rest of Charles Town is a hill leading to sheer cliffs to our right. Tan and gray-colored smoke mixes among bright white clouds against a pale blue sky on the top half of the painting.

artworks.title: New England Farm in Winter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts a winter scene. The horizon is in the top third of the image, with a line of dark evergreen trees below a sky of soft blues and hints of yellow. Closer to us, a flat expanse of land with several buildings on it is covered in snow. A woman and child on the right stand near a house with chickens nearby. The chickens fill the snow, and the woman is turned to the left, one arm outstretched towards them and the other holding a large bowl. The child is behind her legs, looking back at a small cat or dog that stands on the right. The woman and child are in front of a low, blue-gray stone building with a roof covered in snow. Another child looks out from inside the building. On the left, past the chickens, a wooden fence leads to a barn with two horses inside of it. In the center, two cattle stand next to a round shed or silo. Behind these buildings, leafless trees stand with snow on their branches. The color palette includes white, grey, green, and brown.

artworks.title: Lexington Battle Monument
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman riding a white horse along a path in a park. Several people in formal attire walk alongside. In the background, there is a well-maintained lawn with trees and a white monument surrounded by a black fence. The sky is blue with clouds. The color palette includes greens, blues, whites, blacks, and red.

artworks.title: A View of Mount Vernon
artworks.dimensions:
image: 58.4 x 89.2 cm (23 x 35 1/8 in.)
unframed (entire fireboard): 95.3 x 109.5 cm (37 1/2 x 43 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: A three-storied, white manor house with a rust-red roof and wings extending off both sides sits across an emerald-green lawn lined with tall, sage and dark green trees in this horizontal painting. Straw-brown paths lead to the house from either side of the lawn, where they meet an oval-shaped path directly in front of the house. The grassy area inside the oval is cordoned off with posts and weighted chains. Closer to us, three men, two women, and a gray dog stand on the lawn. Two of the men wear uniforms with navy-blue, button-lined jackets with golden yellow epaulets and collars, dark, tricorn hats, and butter-yellow britches over black, knee-high boots. The third man wears a brown suit with a white collar. Both the women wear white dresses. One has a sky-blue sash around her waist and the other has a black shawl wrapped across her torso, and wears a white bonnet. Two light-skinned people, perhaps a man and a child, walk along the path to our left, wearing gray suits. Four people closer to the house have brown skin. One of them, a woman, stands at the front center of the oval path and other three men approach a door in the wing to our left. One of that trio carries a shovel over his shoulder, one a rake, and the other a staff. A carriage guided by a seated horseman and pulled by four horses enters the scene from our right. To our left and right, covered walkways connect the main house to the side wings. The wing to our right is mostly hidden by trees and cut off by the right edge of the painting. The wing to our left has a teal-blue roof, red brick chimneys, and the same white walls as the manor. The main house has a triangular pediment over the front door and chimneys to each side of the red roof. A spire-like lantern is at the center of the roofline, over the pediment. Faint, wispy white clouds billow against the azure-blue sky above. Centered at the bottom of the scene across a white margin are the words, “A VIEW OF MOUNT.VERNON THE SEAT OF GENERAL WASHINGTON.”

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals near a well. One person is standing holding a pitcher in her right hand, while the other is seated on the well's edge. The standing woman has fair skin, a round face, long dark hair tied back, and is wearing a golden yellow dress with a blue underskirt and red shoes. The seated person has long dark hair, a beard, and is wearing a light blue robe. Above the well, there is a pulley with a rope. In the background, there are trees on either side, and in the distance, houses and rolling hills are visible under a blue sky with soft brushstrokes indicating distant clouds.

artworks.title: Young Man on a Terrace
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image displays a young person standing next to a large, ornate vase filled with colorful flowers. The person has dark hair, rosy cheeks, and is wearing an elegant red outfit with a dark green cape. They have a large piece of jewelry on their chest and red footwear. The background features architectural elements and a large, flowing green drapery.

artworks.title: Mahantango Valley Farm
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: We look down at a cluster of three farm buildings and across grassy fields that stretch into the distance in this horizontal landscape painting. A parchment-yellow road angles from the lower center of the composition into the upper right corner, where it meets the horizon line just below the upper edge of the painting. Closest to us, the buildings flank the road, with two barns to our left and a house to our right. The buildings all have burgundy-red roofs. The barns have brown siding, and the house has paler, tan siding. The buildings are surrounded by blue or red fences. The barns to our left have large doors and two windows are visible on one of the sides facing us. A two-story, turquoise-blue bird house is affixed to the side of the barn closer to us. To our right, the house has windows piercing both levels, and a porch facing the road, to our left. Birds gather on the roof of the house, and an American flag flies beyond the back corner of the house. A black horse and two red horses, four cows and bulls, two dogs, a dozen chickens, and two pigs occupy different areas of the fenced-in spaces around the buildings. A man stands near the dogs next to the house, and a person wearing a red-edged black garment and a red cap stands on the road between the structures. In the fields beyond, people ride horses or hunt, horses graze, and a cow frolics with a dog. More buildings dot the landscape, which is farther divided into plots of land by stone walls, black fences, and more roads. Rows of stylized trees grow in straight lines in a grove to our left. Birds and deer walk or stand among the trees, and two people stand nearby, holding rifles. The slopes of indigo-blue hills rise along the horizon, at the top of the painting.  The sky to the left of blue hills is mauve pink, streaked with black clouds. The rest of the sky is pale shell pink and ivory. Many of the animals and the architectural elements are outlined in black and filled in with flat areas of color. The weave of the window shade on which this is painted is visible in many areas.

artworks.title: Farmhouse in Mahantango Valley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a two-story house seen from a high perspective. The house is on the left, and it has horizontal white paneling, a small brown porch, dark windows with green shades, and a tiled roof in shades of red, blue, and black. There are three tall trees behind the house, one with green leaves, one with yellow leaves, and one with sparse dark green leaves. In the distance on the right, there are flat green fields separated by brown paths, more white farmhouses, and pale blue mountains under the blue sky. Closer to us, at the bottom of the painting, two people, a man and a woman, stand in front of the house. They both have pale gray skin and wear formal blue clothing. Around them are various farm animals, including a rabbit, a dog, a cat, a horse, and three cows. There is a long white wall in front of the house and a fence behind it.

artworks.title: The End of the Hunt
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts an outdoor equestrian scene featuring riders on horseback. Closest to us is a low fence of thin wooden logs. Three riders on horseback are jumping over the fence, as are a line of dogs. One of the riders is blowing a horn, and another seems to have fallen off his horse and is sitting on the ground near the bottom right corner. Beyond the fence is a yellow field, and at the edge of the field are two red buildings that more dogs and riders are heading towards. Surrounding the buildings are green trees, and in the background on the right are distant hills painted in grays and browns. The sky above shows blue tones with fluffy white clouds.

artworks.title: Under Full Sail
artworks.medium: oil and casein (?) on plaster and lath
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape with a river, curving hills, and tall trees. A sailing ship with furled sails moves along the river in the center, surrounded by yellow foliage on either bank. In the background, sparse trees line the horizon under a blue sky with wispy white clouds. On the right, we see a yellow house on the edge of the water, smoke coming from the chimney. The color palette is muted, consisting of soft greens and blues with pops of yellow and white.

artworks.dimensions:

overall (size if unfolded edge flattened): 76 x 57.4 cm (29 15/16 x 22 5/8 in.)

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a white vase with gold trim and light blue shadows sitting in the center of a table, which is covered in a brown-and-white checkered cloth with fringed edges. The vase holds colorful flowers like tulips, daisies, and roses in shades of white, red, blue, orange, and pink, and the flowers are surrounded by green stems and leaves. On the table around the vase are several grapes, pears, and peaches in shades of yellow, pink, and blue-green. The background behind the vase and flowers is black.
